sentence: This project studies how abnormal R-loops affect boundary function and genome organization in leukemic cells.
This project uses genome-wide screens to find drug targets that could restore chloride ion channel activity in cystic fibrosis airway cells.
This project studies how a human-specific dopaminergic interneuron in the cerebral cortex works and how it evolved.
This project builds tools that use ion mobility and mass spectrometry to study how an amoeba and a fungus change metabolites during infection.
This project finds and corrects batch effects in genome data and helps combine and display that data for cancer studies.
This project builds tools that map microscopic images of the human brain onto whole-brain coordinate systems and improve image quality.
This project studies how a virus damages junctions between heart cells during infection and how this leads to sudden cardiac death.
This project studies how the order in which mutations occur affects the way cancer starts, using a cell-based model.
This project studies how genes and ancestry shape immune features of breast tumors in women from different populations.
This project builds personalized prediction models and looks for biomarkers to judge which patients with anaphylaxis need long observation periods.
This project studies how age-associated mutations in hematopoietic stem cells weaken immune responses to lung cancer.
This project provides a spinning disk confocal microscope for biomedical research such as cancer therapy and vision research.
This project uses a rat model of cocaine-seeking to study how vagus nerve stimulation reverses synaptic changes and reduces relapse.
This project studies patients with congenital hydrocephalus, using genomics and neuroimaging data to find genetic variants and build a genome browser.
This project builds pangenome-aware methods to find somatic variants in cancer genomes more accurately, using sequencing data from tumor-normal cell line pairs.
This project studies how modified small RNAs activate toll-like receptors and worsen inflammation in Alzheimer’s disease.
This project builds and runs assays that measure viral nucleic acid levels in samples from vaccine studies in nonhuman primates.
This project designs and tests MRI-compatible metamaterial implants and electrode sets.
This project tests whether resiquimod packaged in nanoparticles can help the immune system fight medulloblastoma, a brain cancer in children.
This project studies how social media use and mental health symptoms affect each other in young adolescents.
